In summary, our research is concerned with
the development of low cost, high throughput, solution based, roll to roll processed, polymer based photovoltaic devices.
the development of a new class of polymer solar cells (PSCs).
the development and optimization of the R2R processing of all the layers of a polymer solar cell module.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that

a polymer solar cell module can be prepared in the ambient using all solution processing and full roll to
roll (R2R), with no vacuum steps.
the use of the KOE coating method for the ZnO layer is the most efficient and cost effective method for the preparation of polymer solar cell modules.
the use of the thermoclevable polymer P3MHOCT as the active layer in polymer solar cell devices has the potential of providing a viable alternative to P3HT PC61BM.
